note: Recorded from reference/python apply() with server+trust+restart_ui on chain.p7b + leaf-pkcs1.key (fqdn m.cust.test). put_root data is summarised; secrets and stamped files carry no hash.

sequence.cmd:
echo "HOST=$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname)"
echo "OS=$(. /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; echo "$PRETTY_NAME")"
MC=$(command -v morpheus-ctl || ls /opt/morpheus/bin/morpheus-ctl /usr/bin/morpheus-ctl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "MCTL=$MC"
echo "RB=$( [ -f /etc/morpheus/morpheus.rb ] && echo yes || echo no )"
echo "SSLDIR=$( [ -d /etc/morpheus/ssl ] && echo yes || echo no )"
echo "SYSTEMDRUN=$(command -v systemd-run >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d /run/systemd/system ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "OPENSSL=$(command -v openssl >/dev/null && openssl version | cut -d' ' -f1-2)"
echo "VER=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' morpheus-appliance 2>/dev/null || rpm -q --qf '%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}' morpheus-appliance 2>/dev/null)"
KT=$(ls /opt/morpheus/embedded/java/bin/keytool /opt/morpheus/embedded/java/jre/bin/keytool 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$KT" ] || KT=$(find /opt/morpheus/embedded -maxdepth 6 -type f -name keytool 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "KEYTOOL=$KT"
CA=$(find /opt/morpheus/embedded -maxdepth 8 -type f -name cacerts -path '*security*' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "CACERTS=$CA"
echo "FREE_ETC_KB=$(df -Pk /etc | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')"
echo "FREE_VAR_KB=$(df -Pk /var | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')"

set -e; umask 077; mkdir -p /var/lib/morpheus-certificate-install/backups/{STAMP}; cp -a /etc/morpheus/ssl /var/lib/morpheus-certificate-install/backups/{STAMP}/ssl; cp -a /etc/morpheus/morpheus.rb /var/lib/morpheus-certificate-install/backups/{STAMP}/morpheus.rb; chmod 700 /var/lib/morpheus-certificate-install /var/lib/morpheus-certificate-install/backups 2>/dev/null; echo done

a=$(openssl x509 -noout -pubkey -in /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.crt | sha256sum | cut -c1-64); b=$(openssl pkey -pubout -in /etc/morpheus/ssl/m_cust_test.key | sha256sum | cut -c1-64); echo "cert=$a key=$b"; [ "$a" = "$b" ]

rust_expect_override.why: PARITY divergence 19: apply reads morpheus.rb and runs the appliance_url guard before writing anything; divergence 29: after the key match it records the installed files in the ledger (read + write)
